positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what is the verified calibration status of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, and how is that status established?
positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same directional claim — the instrument is calibrated at 88.4 MHz, verified against the June reference plates, holding across the full observing band — first stated in narrative prose (src-1) and then restated as structured fielded-spec entries (src-2, src-3). Register and conviction reads across all three sit at the same unhedged, technical, competence-grounded register with no gradient between them, supporting one coherent read rather than three separate claims.
